questions.question: Who kills Albus Dumbledore?
questions.note: On the tower, after Draco lowers his wand. Dumbledore says 'Severus, please,' and Snape casts the Killing Curse.

questions.question: Where is Dumbledore killed?
questions.note: They had just returned from the cave. The Dark Mark is already burning over the castle.

questions.question: What does Draco repair so Death Eaters can walk into Hogwarts?
choices: The Floo in the common room
questions.note: Its twin sits in Borgin and Burkes. Anything put in one cabinet comes out of the other.

questions.question: Who is cursed by the opal necklace Draco meant for Dumbledore?
questions.note: She touches the package in Hogsmeade and is lifted into the air. The curse was meant for the headmaster.

questions.question: What does Harry shove down Ron's throat to save him from the poisoned mead?
questions.note: The mead was a gift for Dumbledore. Snape had told the first-years that a bezoar would save you from most poisons.

questions.question: What is the most powerful love potion, the one Slughorn shows in class?
questions.note: It smells different to each person. Harry smells treacle tart, a broomstick handle, and something flowery.

questions.question: Who does Harry start dating in the sixth film?
questions.note: They kiss in the Room of Requirement, after Harry has been hiding his textbook there.

questions.question: Who does Ron date, to Hermione's fury?
questions.note: She calls him Won-Won. The relationship collapses after he is poisoned.

questions.question: What London bridge do the Death Eaters destroy at the start of the sixth film?
questions.note: They kidnap Ollivander from Diagon Alley, then twist the bridge apart. The film added this attack. The book uses a different bridge.

questions.question: Why does Slughorn want to go to Aragog's funeral?
choices: He wants to adopt a spider
He is paying a debt to Hagrid
He thinks the corpse is a Horcrux
questions.note: The venom is rare and valuable. Harry goes along, dosed with Felix Felicis, and comes back with Slughorn's true memory.
